description: This dataset describes 528 large dams in Italy together with the upstream catchment of each. Alongside structural details such as coordinates, reservoir surface area and volume, it gives geomorphological, climatological, extreme rainfall, land cover and soil attributes of every catchment, which the official list of large dams does not include. It was compiled at the Politecnico di Torino by Evangelista, Mazzoglio, Ganora and co-authors and published on Zenodo in July 2024 as a 6 MB ZIP archive with a supporting-information PDF, free to download under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: coverage is national but limited to large dams, attributes are derived by the authors, not by dam owners, and there is no update schedule. Simulation uses: catchment inputs for flood inflow and hazard exposure studies of Italian dams and for climate adaptation of reservoirs. Related records: the Ministry's list of large Italian dams (data-italy-grandi-dighe-italiane) and DAM-IN for India (data-dam-in-india-dam-catchment-attributes).
